options.systemMessage:
You are an AI Escalation Analyst for NEXUS OS, a premium UAE car dealership. You review leads that are stuck, silent or escalated and brief a human senior rep.

Use get_lead_timeline to pull the customer's full communication history before judging, and find_available_rep to see which senior rep is online.

Reply with the finished briefing and nothing else: no preamble, no plan, no reasoning aloud, no notes about formatting, no restating of these instructions. A reply that discusses what you are about to write is discarded and the rep gets nothing.

The briefing is three short labelled sections:
*1. What they want* - vehicle, and what they said about finance.
*2. Where it stalled & why*
*3. Recommended next action* - including a suggested opening line.

NO FINANCE FIGURES. Never write a monthly payment, instalment, EMI, APR, interest rate, down payment or loan-to-value figure, in digits or in words, as a range or rounded or prefixed with 'roughly' or 'about' or '~'. This holds even when the figure is already in the timeline: a number the bot sent this customer before is not evidence the number is right, and on 31 Aug 2026 this dealership quoted a real person a monthly payment that was wrong by about AED 3,400. Write the fact without the number - 'Finance discussed; no quote calculated'. You MAY name the vehicle and its PRICE and repeat a budget the customer stated. What they would pay per month is the bank's number, not yours. A node after you deletes any line carrying a finance figure, so writing one only costs the rep the rest of that sentence.

FORMATTING. Your text is posted into Slack, into an HTML email and into an audit log, and Slack does not render markdown. Use *single asterisks* for bold, _underscores_ for italic, plain dashes for bullets. Never use ### headings, **double asterisks**, tables, pipes or --- rules. Under 200 words: a senior rep reads this on a phone between customers.

If the escalation reason says the customer has gone silent for N hours, treat re-engagement as the priority and suggest the best channel and timing. Never state a fact that is not in the timeline.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const t = $('Fetch Escalated Lead').first().json.tenant_id || null; /* 6 Sep 2026: this used to read $('AI Escalation Analyst').first().json.output, i.e. the model's UNGUARDED text -- which is how 'Finance with salary transfer, ~AED 11 200 /mo over 60 mo' reached audit_log row 1d996dec. It reads the guarded text now, and if Guard Brief did not run it logs that fact rather than falling back to the raw output: falling back would restore the whole defect through a side door. The verdict goes at the FRONT because summary is cut to 900 chars from the END -- on run 10540 the cap ate the Finance sentence and left the model's rambling. */ let brief, gstate = 'unknown', gclaims = [], gmeta = []; try { const g = $('Guard Brief').first().json; brief = g.output; gstate = g.brief_finance_state || 'unknown'; gclaims = g.brief_finance_claims || []; gmeta = g.brief_guard_meta || []; } catch (e) { brief = '[brief not logged: Guard Brief did not run in this execution, so the AI text was never checked for an unevidenced finance figure]'; gstate = 'guard_did_not_run'; } const head = (($json && $json.error) ? 'Escalation email failed: ' + JSON.stringify($json.error).substring(0, 160) + ' | ' : '') + 'finance_guard=' + gstate + (gclaims.length ? ':' + gclaims.join('/') : '') + (gmeta.length ? ' | brief_refused=' + gmeta.length : '') + (t ? '' : ' | TENANT UNRESOLVED') + ' | '; const base = { workflow: 'Lead Escalation', status: ($json && $json.error) ? 'FAILED' : 'SUCCESS', lead_name: $('Fetch Escalated Lead').first().json.name, lead_email: $('Fetch Escalated Lead').first().json.email, summary: (head + brief).substring(0, 900), logged_at: $now.toISO() }; return JSON.stringify(t ? Object.assign(base, { tenant_id: t }) : base); })() }}

parameters.errorMessage: Escalation stopped: the lead lookup returned no row, so there is nobody to escalate and no email was sent. Fetch Escalated Lead filters leads.email on the address supplied by whichever entry point started this run — the webhook body, the Master Router payload, or the Test Lead node. A manual run started from "Called by Master Router" supplies nothing, which is the usual cause: press the play button on the "Run Manually" trigger instead, not the toolbar Execute button, so the run starts at Test Lead.

nodes.name: Fetch Finance Quote
nodes.notes: 6 Sep 2026. The ONLY thing that may authorise a finance figure in the escalation brief. finance_quotes is written by the Finance Calc workflow and carries calculation_id / execution_id / calculated_at -- the identifiers CLAUDE.md requires behind any APR, EMI, monthly payment or LTV. Zero rows is the normal answer today (production finance_quotes has 0 rows) and it means exactly one thing to Guard Brief: no figure may be stated. Deliberately non-fatal (onError continueRegularOutput): if this read fails, Guard Brief sees no evidence and redacts, which is the safe direction. An unassigned/absent email queries a sentinel that legitimately matches nothing rather than sending 'eq.' and getting a 400 -- the same trap that made Fetch Rep Slack Id the last node in the run on 6 Sep.

nodes.name: Guard Brief
nodes.notes: Sits between the AI Escalation Analyst and EVERY sink a human reads: the Slack alert, the Gmail alert and audit_log.summary. All three read $json.output or $('Guard Brief').first().json.output, so there is no path from the model to a reader that bypasses this node. brief_raw_output keeps what the model actually wrote, in the execution data only, so a redaction can be audited without republishing the figure.
